reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Konika Bell
reviews.text: I called last summer to get wiring to an upstairs bonus room & bathroom and an outside bathroom. Stephen did what he said he would do & was reasonably priced. Sometimes it takes him a day or so to get back in touch; but he can’t be on the phone if he’s working it’s a small business & I understand that. Text works best, it’s easy to forget to respond when you get busy, I do it. So I found I would give him a day or so to respond and would text again. He would always reply. He does what he says he’s going to do. You just have to remember in construction and home repair etc. schedules are sometimes fluid and change so flexibility is best. I was finally able to finish my project and Stephen finished it all up in a day. If you want to support local businesses which I do, he is a great choice very fair and reliable. I passed inspection today all of his wiring was great. My favorite thing is the flood light he installed for me. He was nice enough to pick out a really good one and just let me reimburse him for it since it wasn’t part of what he would supply for my project, it was an add on.I would absolutely call him for future needs.

reviews.author: Lane
reviews.text: Stephen completed a large project running wiring to our dock and hooking up electrical and a water pump there. His work is thorough and very professional and we passed inspection with no problem. He also installed several new garage lights for me and did an excellent job. I recommend him highly.

reviews.author: John Pyle
reviews.text: Stephen went over and above to fix an electrical problem at a rental of mine. He communicated very well and was there when he said he would and his prices were very fair. I plan on using his services at all my rentals in the area going forward.

reviews.author: Amanda Francica
reviews.text: Stephen and Jamie located and repaired all electrical issues we were experiencing in an impressive amount of time. Both gentlemen were extremely professional and talked us through what changes they were making. Stephen was easy to talk to in the days leading up to our service appointment. These are the folks you want working your electrical. We are happy to have worked with them and will contact them for every future need!!

reviews.author: Jeremy Barker
reviews.text: I've had the pleasure of using Wilson electrical services to hook up my HVAC install, he really knows his stuff. Friendly, courteous and his prices are more than fair. I would recommend Wilson electrical services to anyone in need of any type of electrical work. Stephen and Sheila are great people and hard workers, proud to call them friends.

reviews.author: Donna Randolph
reviews.text: We called Wilson Electrical to fix our electrical system up to code. They called me back in a timely manner and showed up on time. They did not over charge me, nor did they take advantage of me. I was very pleased with their professionalism and manners. I highly recommend this company on a job well done and for being honest.

reviews.author: Jason Curtis
reviews.text: I have used Wilson Electric Services on numerous job sites where I've had needs for a fair and honest electrician. On every occasion he was on time, professional and his price for his services are second to none. Getting two of these three needed qualities are a blessing, all three are almost improbable. I'm thankful I came across Wilson Electric Services and plan on continuing to use their services.

reviews.author: Scott Meier
reviews.text: I've known Stephen for a few years now. I am a kitchen and bath remodeler and I have used his services on several large remodeling projects as well as smaller jobs and he treats each one with the same attention and commitment to doing a good job. I have had customers remark to me how well he handles any type of problem in a courteous and workmanlike manner. On several occasions he has gone above and beyond the call of duty to finish a job on schedule and budget. He has also bailed me out when the original electrician screwed up a job and I had to let him go. I heartily recommend Wilson electric for any size project.

reviews.author: Charlie Dover
reviews.text: I had him rewire alot of my outlets when we bought our house and he did a great job. Very affordable and very friendly. I was so pleased with his work I even called him back to fix a short in a light in one of my bedrooms. It's so hard to find reliable people but I will definately call him again if and when I ever need to. Thank you Steven for all you done for us.

reviews.author: Breonna Rozier
reviews.text: Called about getting a breaker replaced. I was instructed to send a picture and Wilson Electrical instructed me on how to troubleshoot the issue saving me so much money. I appreciate the professionalism and willingness to help! I will definitely use them for any future issues.

reviews.author: Michael mccraw
reviews.text: Steven is a really great guy. He saved us on Christmas Eve. He drove an hour and a half to Lake Lure. I was back up and running in no time. Would highly suggest Stephen Wilson

reviews.author: Joseph Conner
reviews.text: What can I say...WOW!! This guy knows what he's doing I had 3 big companies come out before him and they were all high priced and I let 1 of them do the work and they blew almost everything​in my house. I ran them off and called Steven he came out and had me set and everything working right before he left and the price was good.

reviews.author: Arthur Rogers
reviews.text: We have had three different projects done over three-years and are very happy with all work and prices paid. Recommend you give Stephan Wilson a call for your next electrical project!

reviews.author: darrell drum
reviews.text: They were on time, professional and courteous. Mr. Wilson wired a 16x32 building for me and we are very pleased with the job that was done and the price was the best I had found after soespeak to several contractors.

reviews.author: E Jarratt
reviews.text: I used Wilson for a whole house rewire for a rental property. They were prompt and on-time and budget. Really loved the professionalism and would use for future rehab/rentals.

reviews.author: Pudden Tang
reviews.text: Came to fix an air condition problem. Done a great job. Would recommend his services to anyone with an electrical problem. Excellent service!!!

reviews.author: Daddy PhatNuts
reviews.text: My Aunt got services from him and had plans at the time she paid him so she paid him in advance and he's not finished the job and is YET to return... I HIGHLY RECOMMEND anyone reading this DO NOT get services from this man or his company

reviews.author: Brandon Adams
reviews.text: Stephen charged a diagnostic fee and said he would come back to fix it the next morning. He was a no call/no show two days in a row.
